latestVersion.changelog:
snapdom 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a DOM capture engine to export any DOM subtree as SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP, Canvas, or Blob.
- Supports inline styles, fonts, background images, pseudo-elements, and Shadow DOM.
- Includes both shortcut “one-off” export methods and a reusable capture API.
- Offers configurable options: scale, output dimensions, quality, background color, font embedding, CORS proxy support, filtering, and exclusion.
- Integrates with official plugin system and provides plugin lifecycle hooks.
- Provides xbrowser integration recommendations for browser automation contexts.
